body: I see dim lights from inside the train flickering on when the doors close softly behind me. A sense of unease washes over me as I realize they might need help navigating through such an unfamiliar environment. My impulse to protect grows stronger. I step forward tentatively, my heart racing but also filled with a newfound determination to ensure their safety. I move slowly, trying not to cause any disturbances, and reach out gently to touch one of their hands. Their fingers are cool against mine, and their eyes are wide with fear mixed with uncertainty. I take a deep breath, focusing on keeping them calm and secure.
